The geometric remainder bound R=1250000/85766121 is valid for every later derivative since |f′|>=21/20. The credited Ito–Tanaka–Nakada density representation has Z>0, and on (779/800,1) all first 17 indicators are one, so normalized density rho>=(H-R)/(I+R)=170333841/67511439>5/2. The interval has length 21/800; strictly open finite-branch inequalities persist for nearby parameters. This is an analytic geometric tail argument paired with an independently recomputed exact finite certificate, not finite iteration taken as an infinite proof.
